table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name,
	saleitemdesc= max(saledetail.saleitemdescription),
	salecatcode=saleledger.salecatcode,   
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	accname =dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	city= dbo.customer.city,   
	licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	username= dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	fiscalinvoiceno=max(saleledger.fiscalinvoiceno),
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
	headerinvno=saleledger.headerinvno,  
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	modifycounter = dbo.saleledger.modifycounter, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
	packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
	salestax = max(saledetail.salestax),  
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	custref2=saleledger.custrefno2,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	salesman=ltrim(rtrim(dbo.salesman.name)),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=item.manfcode),
	CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientaddress=(select address1 from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	cashreceived=saleledger.cashcharged +(select isnull(sum(amount),0) from cashierwindow where cashierwindow.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode),
	PackCapacity = item.PackCapacity,
	AreaVolume = item.AreaVolume,
	PCS=ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume IS NULL OR item.AreaVolume <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE item.AreaVolume END, 6),
	Cartons= LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(CAST(((ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6)) / CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END) AS INT), 7, 0))) + ' : ' +
		LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(((CAST(ROUND(sum(saledetail.looseqty) / CASE WHEN item.AreaVolume > 0 THEN item.AreaVolume ELSE 1 END, 6) AS INT)) % CAST(CASE WHEN item.PackCapacity > 0 THEN item.PackCapacity ELSE 1 END AS INT)), 7, 0)))
FROM 
	saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN DBO.SalesMan ON (dbo.saleledger.smancode = dbo.salesman.salesmancode),   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode=:ar_InvCode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	 ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
GROUP BY
	item.name,
	saleledger.salecatcode,   
	item.customicode,   
	item.packingdesc, 
	dbo.accounts.name,   
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,   
	dbo.customer.city,   
	dbo.customer.licenceno,   
	dbo.users.username,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.headerno, 
	saleledger.headerinvno,  
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.modifycounter, 
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	saledetail.gcode,   
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.packunits, 
	saledetail.saleprice, 
	saledetail.discperc, 
	saledetail.itemflatdisc, 
	saleledger.posted, 
	saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	customer.salestaxregno, 
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	saleledger.custrefno2,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.salesman.name,
	item.manfcode,
	item.PackCapacity,
	item.AreaVolume,
	ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	saleledger.patientcode,
	saleledger.patientcode,
	saleledger.cashcharged
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
	ID

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: sum(TRUNCATE(ROUND((looseqty / if(areavolume > 0, areavolume, 1)),6) / if(packcapacity > 0, packcapacity, 1), 0)  for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)
